heading: Limitation on application of tribal funds
lead: No funds belonging to any Indian tribe with which treaty relations exist shall be applied in any manner not authorized by such treaty, or by express provisions of law; nor shall money appropriated to execute a treaty be transferred or applied to any other purpose, unless expressly authorized by law.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: R.S. § 2097 derived from act July 26, 1866, ch. 266, § 2, 14 Stat. 280.
